title: MCT pull result
description: Fulfilled, reduced, redacted, or denied pull. Object kind 'pull_result'. Design ref: §7.3, §8.5, §10.2. Every returned object retains source lineage (invariant 8).

objects.description: Result objects. Present for exact/reduced/summarized/redacted; typically empty for denied/not_found/budget_exhausted/approval_required.

source.description: Immutable source snapshot the excerpt was cut from (invariant 8, §13.4).

omitted.description: Accounting for content deliberately not returned (§25.4).

denial_reason.description: Explicit, structured reason so A can reformulate rather than repeat (§10.3). Present for denied/not_found/budget_exhausted/approval_required.

policy_revision.description: Policy snapshot revision that governed this decision (§18.2).
